FD1.meaning: FDA may regulate it: file FDA data if FDA-regulated, otherwise disclaim

FD2.meaning: FDA-regulated (not food): FDA entry data must be filed

FD3.meaning: May be food: if food, file FDA Prior Notice + entry data; if not, disclaim

FD4.meaning: Food: FDA Prior Notice and entry data must be filed

AQ1.agencyName: USDA Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service
AQ1.meaning: APHIS data needed if a permit/certificate is required for the item; else disclaim

AQ2.agencyName: USDA Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service
AQ2.meaning: APHIS plant/animal health data must be filed

AQX.agencyName: USDA Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service
AQX.meaning: APHIS data may be required; no disclaim needed if not

AL1.agencyName: USDA Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service
AL1.meaning: Lacey Act plant declaration may be required (plant content)

AL2.agencyName: USDA Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service
AL2.meaning: Lacey Act plant declaration (PPQ 505 data) is required

AL1/AL2.agencyName: USDA Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service
AL1/AL2.meaning: On APHIS Lacey Act schedule: plant declaration required for plant content (de minimis/exempt aside)

FS3.agencyName: USDA Food Safety and Inspection Service
FS3.meaning: May be meat, poultry or egg product: FSIS data if so, else disclaim

FS4.agencyName: USDA Food Safety and Inspection Service
FS4.meaning: Meat, poultry or egg product: FSIS inspection data must be filed

AM1.meaning: AMS egg-products data may be required (e.g. inedible egg products)

AM2.meaning: Shell eggs: AMS data must be filed

AM3.meaning: AMS marketing-order (8e quality) data may be required

AM4.meaning: Marketing-order produce: AMS quality inspection data required (seasonal/min-qty exemptions)

AM6.meaning: Peanuts: AMS peanut quality data must be filed

AM7.meaning: If sold as organic: NOP Import Certificate data may be required

AM8.meaning: Certified-organic product: NOP Import Certificate data must be filed

TB1.agencyName: Alcohol and Tobacco Tax and Trade Bureau
TB1.meaning: Alcohol or tobacco: TTB data may be required

TB2.agencyName: Alcohol and Tobacco Tax and Trade Bureau
TB2.meaning: Alcohol or tobacco: TTB data must be filed

TB3.agencyName: Alcohol and Tobacco Tax and Trade Bureau
TB3.meaning: TTB data may be required; can only be disclaimed with code A or C

EP1.meaning: May be an ozone-depleting substance: EPA ODS data if so, else disclaim

EP2.meaning: Ozone-depleting substance: EPA ODS data must be filed

EP3.meaning: May be an engine/vehicle under EPA emission rules: EPA data if so, else disclaim

EP4.meaning: Vehicle or engine: EPA emissions data must be filed

EP5.meaning: May be a pesticide or device: EPA pesticide data (NOA) if so, else disclaim

EP6.meaning: Pesticide: EPA pesticide data must be filed

EP7.meaning: TSCA chemical/article (e.g. composite wood): TSCA certification data may be required

EP8.meaning: TSCA certification data must be filed

EP7/EP8.meaning: Composite wood: TSCA Title VI import certification may be required (EPA 2019 list)

EH1.meaning: May be a bulk HFC: EPA HFC data if so; only disclaim code A allowed

EH2.meaning: Regulated bulk HFC: EPA HFC data (allowance) must be filed

CP1.meaning: CPSC certificate data may be needed if product is under a CPSC rule; else may disclaim

CP2.meaning: CPSC certificate of compliance data must be eFiled

DT1.meaning: May be motor vehicle equipment: NHTSA HS-7 data, or disclaim A if not

DT2.meaning: Motor vehicle or regulated equipment: NHTSA HS-7 data must be filed

FW1.meaning: May contain wildlife: FWS declaration (3-177) if so, else disclaim

FW2.meaning: Wildlife product: FWS declaration and clearance data required

FW3.meaning: Wildlife needing FWS clearance; filed in ACE or eDecs (disclaim C/D says where)

NM1.meaning: May contain tuna: NOAA Form 370 data if it does, else disclaim

NM2.meaning: Tuna: NOAA Form 370 / tuna tracking data must be filed

NM1/NM2.meaning: Tuna Tracking (Form 370) program code: NOAA data may or must be filed

NM3.meaning: May be Antarctic species (toothfish etc.): AMLR data if so

NM4.meaning: Antarctic marine living resources: AMLR permit/catch data required

NM3/NM4.meaning: Antarctic Marine Living Resources program code: NOAA AMLR data may or must be filed

NM5.meaning: May be swordfish/bluefin tuna etc.: HMS data if so

NM6.meaning: Highly migratory species: HMS permit/document data required

NM5/NM6.meaning: Highly Migratory Species program code: NOAA HMS data may or must be filed

NM8.meaning: SIMP species: NOAA harvest/landing data and IFTP number must be filed

OM1.agencyName: State Dept. Office of Marine Conservation
OM1.meaning: Shrimp: State Dept DS-2031 data may be required

OM2.agencyName: State Dept. Office of Marine Conservation
OM2.meaning: Shrimp: State Dept DS-2031 data is required

OM1/OM2.agencyName: State Dept. Office of Marine Conservation
OM1/OM2.meaning: Shrimp: State Dept DS-2031 (turtle-safe harvest) declaration program

DE1.meaning: May be a DEA controlled substance or listed chemical: DEA data if so

DE3.meaning: May be a tableting/encapsulating machine: DEA regulated-machine data if so
